cases.prompt: Have the spec-orchestrator drive remaining stations and hand back a CLARIFY_PACKET without asking me
Run spec-analyst on the intake report so analysis.json records gap scores and conflicts
Ask spec-interrogator for a batched questions packet from open gaps, not a user prompt
Have spec-enricher fill remaining gaps and persist assumptions into enriched.json
Run spec-completeness to mechanically score the 10-category checklist into completeness.json
Have spec-synthesizer write the hybrid YAML Markdown spec.md still in reviewing status
Use spec-diagram to append Mermaid into the Visual Reference from the validated spec
Have spec-review-facilitator compose the review packet and apply my requested spec edits
